findings.resolution: The count fell because a defect stopped inventing keywords (006 T049), not because any keyword stopped being classified. All 144 values dropped carry a printed separator and are composites no page prints; the 66 gained are the real keywords they hid, all classified. Distinct UNCLASSIFIED keywords -- what this check watches -- is 18 in both releases.
